Both are genuinely fixed: in Figure 2 (the Venn diagram) the halting-problem marker sits with its bottom edge at y=58 while the 'halting problem' baseline is at y=72 (cap-height top around y=63) — a clean ~5-unit gap, confirmed visually in mobile-light-part11.png, mobile-dark-part11.png, desktop-light-part08.png and desktop-dark-part08.png: the dot sits clearly above the caption text with white space between them, not overlapping it. issues.location: First code block, id=subset-sum-verifier ('## What does "NP" mean — checking, not solving?'), the `correctPick` and `wrongPick` array-literal lines and their trailing comments.
issues.problem: At 390 px (mobile-light-part03.png / mobile-dark equivalent) `bool[] correctPick = [true, false, false, false, false, false, true, true];   // 8 + 21 + 4` and the `wrongPick` line below it are clipped after roughly 40 characters, hiding several of the boolean values and the entire trailing comment that explains which items each certificate picks. This is the very first code example on the page and the one the running 'candidate A / candidate B' example depends on, so a phone reader cannot see, without side-scrolling, why candidate A is valid and candidate B is not.
issues.fixLooksLike: Move the explanatory comment above the line ('// candidate A: 8 + 21 + 4') instead of trailing it, or break the array literal across two lines / shorten the item list so the full boolean sequence fits within about 40 columns; re-run tools/run-code.mjs and re-screenshot mobile to confirm the certificate values are visible without scrolling.
